props.name: source
props.comment: The field path; humanized (or key-translated) when no `label` is given.

props.name: resource
props.comment: Target resource for the translation key; defaults to the ambient resource.

props.name: label
props.comment: A string is translated; `false`/`""` renders nothing. Pass a node via the default slot.

props.name: isRequired
props.comment: Append a thin-space `*` required marker after the label.
